set.body:
Supporting track: Pitch.

Acceptance
1. A ten-minute script that walks the four journeys in the order of docs/plan.md, on the pilot instance with the real study where that is permitted and the seeded study otherwise. It replaces the ten-beat script in docs/build-plan.md section 7.
2. The seeded instance has two labs, named people, the multi-modal study (SEE7), an archive, and one study with a finding to fix live.
3. Two full run-throughs with a stopwatch, one of them in front of someone outside the project.
4. A screen recording of a clean run, kept as the fallback.

Start from
scripts/demo-instance.py and docs/build-plan.md section 7.
set.title: PITCH1: Demo script, seeded data and a recorded fallback (was D14)
